summary: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, computer security expert, strong advocate for privacy and anonymity, uses Tor and VPNs extensively, interested in cryptography and digital rights, engaged in discussions about government surveillance and civil liberties, has a technical background in Linux and virtualization, supports the use of compartmentalization in online activities, critical of pharmaceutical industry practices, follows developments in cryptocurrency, particularly Bitcoin, and its use for anonymous transactions, has a nuanced understanding of drug policy and harm reduction, identifies as an anarchist and transhumanist, has a history of mental health challenges, including bipolar disorder, values freedom of speech and privacy, participates in online communities focused on technology and privacy advocacy.
